limitations: Fourteen newly reported people (12 postnatal and two terminated fetuses): six deletions46kb–2.2Mb, four truncating and four missense variants. Clinical ascertainment through Ithaca/ACLF; retrospective heterogeneous single/trio exomes and arrays, no population comparator or blinded syndrome classification. Two mapped patients P7/P13 have truncating alleles, not contiguous deletions.

Table1 source transcript NM058243.2 differs from packet NM001379291.1. P7 c703C>T/pGln235Ter and P13 c137dup/pPro47AlafsTer8 match c/p notation, but transcript equivalence and GRCh38 genomic placement not independently aligned. P13 packet g15272968dup versus left-alignedVCFchr19:15272962C>CG is an unresolved normalization shift, not automatically a contradiction. S1 unavailable means zygosity and parental origin cannot be independently verified.

No new variant-specific functional assay in this study. Y430C prior histone-binding loss-of-function cited from Olley2018; positioning new missense variants near alpha helices does not demonstrate identical mechanism. Thr295Pro lies in disordered region, and generic IDR molecular-dynamics citation does not establish this allele pathogenic. Figure1 caption labels three helical variants A/B/C whereas B is the IDR variant and D is Y430C; visible panel labels clarify.

Large deletion phenotypes may reflect contiguous genes. Authors state nine neighboring genes do not meet their historical pHI high-rank threshold; prediction cannot exclude dosage effects, second alleles or multilocus etiologies. The narrow46kbP3 deletion supports BRD4 involvement but is not proof of sole causality across2.2Mb deletions. No raw array/exome data independently analyzed.

All12postnatalcases described as initial GDD but only5/11olderthan3years ID; four learning difficulties and two normal-range IQ. P9 adult totalIQ73 and heterogeneous verbal82/performance67 differ from uncomplicated normal intelligence. Meanage15 and cohortincludes10weekinfant; developmental and psychiatric phenotypes are age-dependent. Negative genotype–phenotype correlation in14cases does not establish equivalence.

Psychiatric disorder prevalence5/11 includes broad poor socialization category and specific diagnoses. P7 DMDD/IED/OCD explicit; absence of a psychosis diagnosis in that list is not a documented negative psychiatric assessment. Table1 minus for broad Other or BrainMRI means none reported in that category, not proof of specifically excluded VSD/structural defect with confirmed testing. Slash/NA are unassessed or missing, never negative.

P13 has learning difficulties without ID in Table1, absent from packet; long/narrow fingers coded arachnodactyly is a qualified mapping. P7 microcephaly at exactly−2SD is an author-label/threshold edge, not severe microcephaly. P7 DMDD/IED omitted by packet while OCD compressed to compulsive behavior. No direct contradiction in mapped features established from inspected main.

All main text, both figures and entire patient table read. S1 molecular details/segregation and S2 images unread. Raw data available only on request per paper and not obtained; no author contact. Prior cited experiments not independently reproduced by this source audit.
